tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Conditions as per Bid Documents
The Rates should be mentioned inclusive of all taxes Including Training Charges and GST Charges
The successful bidder is required to pledge 5% of the total amount as performance secutiry Deposit. Which will be returned only after obtaining satisfactory certificate from the concerned authority

The Supply and Training Plan shall be evaluated under technical criteria. Incomplete or vague plans may lead to reduction in marks or rejection. Bidder Must upload Capability & Support of Installation

Bidder should submit one sample item to RWSSD Division RAMANAGARA after the tender submission, during technical evaluation for the verification/ inspection. The sample will be evaluated as a part of technical assessment
To Qualify for Award of This Contract bidders must be capable of supply within the period of 45 days.
Necessary arrangement and requirement for the training will be born by the selected agency.
The training schedule and time will be notified to the selected agency after the finalization of tender
